body:
Looks already done for the most part on `upstream/main` (`4d4a81fcf`).
PR #2151 (commit `ec8fd4b06`, merged in `aaddb2d48`, shipped in `v0.23.0` for `#258`) added the Post dialog and per-post options.

What exists on `upstream/main` (`4d4a81fcf`):
- `declaredOptions` format, schema parsing, validation, and documentation in `crates/post/src/post/options.rs`, `crates/post/src/post/options_parse.rs`, and `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`.
- Option extraction without running the program via `declared_options` and `posting::declared_options_for_post`.
- The desktop Post dialog with `Settings` and `Operations` tabs, grouped property grid, tooltips, and reset in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs`, `post_dialog_tabs.rs`, and `post_script_options.rs`.
- Project persistence (`PostScriptOptions`), undoable commands (`SetPostScriptOptions`, `SetSetupPostScriptOptions`, `SetPostSettings`), early validation (`validate_for_post`), MCP tools (`get_post_options`, `set_post_options`), and CLI flags (`--post-option`, `--option`).
- `declaredOptions` in ten shipped posts: `carvera.cps`, `doosan-dnm.cps`, `fanuc.cps`, `grblhal.cps`, `haas.cps`, `linuxcnc.cps`, `mach4.cps`, `mazak.cps`, `tinyg.cps`, and `tormach.cps`.
- Pinning suites in `crates/post/tests/declared_options.rs`, `crates/app/tests/post_script_options.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tests.rs`, `crates/post/tests/mach4_trunnion.rs`, and `crates/app/tests/tinyg_post.rs`.

Remaining differences from `#2049` on `upstream/main` (`4d4a81fcf`):
- `post_script_options::render_draft` returns early when `schema.is_empty()`, so the Post dialog shows no empty state for a post without options.
- Option tooltips show `description` only and do not show the default value text.
- Eight shipped posts do not define `declaredOptions`: `sinumerik.cps`, `heidenhain.cps`, `fanuc-lathe.cps`, `tormach-lathe.cps`, `tormach-plasma.cps`, `wire-iso.cps`, `sodick-wire.cps`, and `sinker-iso.cps`.

Suggest closing `#2049` (and opening small follow-up issues if the empty state or remaining posts are wanted); the maintainer decides.
